interface.shortDescription: Generate, repair, and turn characters into sticker packs.
interface.longDescription: Furry Image Studio is a Codex / ChatGPT Desktop skill plugin for character generation, targeted image repair, transformations, and personalized reaction sticker packs. The sticker workflow interviews for communication style, approves ten reaction performances, blocks poses cheaply, repairs one sticker at a time, applies character references only after pose approval, and can publish approved static sets to Telegram from a local helper. It can also route an explicitly named private DIDdy alter through an installed local bridge without publishing private references.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me create, transform, or repair a furry character image, or make a personalized ten-reaction sticker pack.
